notes.title: Welcome To The Backrooms Is Officially Dead.... We're Sorry..
notes.content:
As I am sure you are aware. Welcome to the backrooms is officially dead. We don't have any plans for development any further at this time. We sincerely apologize for not achieving what we had promised to all of you. This is a message coming directly from the lead of this team. We are a very small indie studio, and this was our very first game, the community we built up over the past few years has changed my life, and our team genuinely loves our community and cares for all of you. Things don't always go as planned, life gets in the way. etc. and we hope you all understand. This is not the end though. As we have learned a lot from developing welcome to the backrooms.

With that.. We currently have a second game in development, and we hope that you will come along for the ride with us! The game is called "Arcane Arena", and it is a 2D, top down, pixel art, arena pvp game where you choose a deck of 5 cards, (abilities)  such as fireballs, lasers, illusions, shockwaves, etc. and battle it out in 1v1, 2v2, or 1v1v1 modes in either a competitive or casual environment. It has online multiplayer and local 4 person offline modes with controller support! if that sounds like something you are interested in, then you are in the right place!

IF YOU HAVE PURCHASED WELCOME TO THE BACKROOMS OR OWN WELCOME TO THE BACKROOMS ON STEAM, YOU WILL BE COMPESATED WITH A COMPETITIVE MATCHMAKING PASS AND COSMETICS / OTHER ITEMS THAT WE ARE CURRENTLY DECIDING ON IN ARCANE ARENA

Welcome To The Backrooms is now free to play for everyone on steam! We will not be taking it down, as we feel that would be disrespectful to all of those who have bought the game in the past.

This is our thank you, and our apology to our community and those who have decided to give welcome to the backrooms a chance.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/WNZuNcgqJB]Our Discord Hub[/url]

This discord server will now server the purpose of being a hub for all of our games, you are welcome to leave or stay, and we would not blame you. But we thank you for being a part of our community nevertheless! Again we apologize for any inconvenience or disappointment we may have caused. 

-- The Brickmade Productions Development Team ❤️

notes.title: How To Craft Your First Weapon
notes.content:
Crafting weapons is essential to be able to explore the backrooms and have a way to protect yourself from entities. This tutorial will show you how to craft your first axe in WTTB.

1. The first step is to find a sharp object such as a boxcutter: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/53923ade0c2c0f6ce8df518394390e6a585e1d3e.png[/img]

2. Pickup the boxcutter, put in your left hand. Then go find a chair as you will need the wood to craft the handle and the head. Destroy the chair by jumping on it or punching it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/98f50f63a196d2d314df7a43853784d6e9cd8b69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/cc3c629254cf89a8ed2138ca5bda97437913976d.png[/img]

3. Next, pickup a chair leg, and drag the boxcutter over the chair leg in your inventory, this will shave the leg to create a smoothed weapon base stick, which can be used to create an axe by putting an axe head through it (Wooden) or around it (Steel). Do the same with the base of the chair to create an axe head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/e651cee3d23c7170b6d6aaa88e6f6a6583126aa4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/cd6dcfbea2080b7b1f6b37d9b48bb7982cdd0aff.png[/img]

4. You can now drag the axe head over the smoothed weapon base stick to create an axe, currently the axe only has 50 hits before it will break. You now must go find some rope coil to reinforce it (drag the rope coil onto the axe as well). After that, you will have a finished axe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/1d73c9a55cec6049c511e5d67589043f934dfac8.png[/img]

Non-reinforced axe
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690207/94d1420a4e2f7c0263e5c4d8655ca576645a4dfc.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome To The Backrooms - Early Access v1.0.0 is OUT!
notes.content:
[h1]Current Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Infinite level 0 and level 1 backrooms to explore and survive in
[*] Several (30+) weapons, tools, and items to find and use.
[*] Level specific events
[*] Currently 1 entity, although in most situations your environment is more of a threat than they are.....
[*] Fully functionally crafting system with 5+ crafting recipes
[*] Super in-depth player health system including: Thirst, body temperature, sanity, stamina, heartrate, jump limiter, and hunger.
[/list]
